Title: Verify that the QR_SIGNING_KEY environment variable overrides the default signing key value in qr.bangla configuration
Section: QR Code Bangla Signing Key Environment Override
Preconditions: The updated application.yml is deployed; the application reads qr.bangla.signing-key from the environment variable QR_SIGNING_KEY when set, falling back to the default 1234ABCD9876ZXCV otherwise
Steps:
1. Set the environment variable QR_SIGNING_KEY to a custom value (e.g., 'CUSTOM_KEY_2024'). 2. Start the application with the updated configuration. 3. Read the resolved qr.bangla.signing-key property. 4. Confirm it equals the environment variable value, not the default.

Test Data: Default value: 1234ABCD9876ZXCV; Environment override: CUSTOM_KEY_2024
Expected Result: The qr.bangla.signing-key property resolves to the QR_SIGNING_KEY environment variable value (CUSTOM_KEY_2024) instead of the hardcoded default, preventing use of the insecure default key in production.

Title: Verify that all new qr.bangla properties (guid, signing-key, signature-length) are correctly bound with their specified values
Section: QR Code Bangla Property Binding Values
Preconditions: The updated application.yml is deployed; the application has started successfully; no QR_SIGNING_KEY environment variable is set so the default signing key is used
Steps:
1. Start the application with the updated application.yml. 2. Read the qr.bangla configuration properties from the application context. 3. Verify guid equals 'com.my.uuid', signing-key equals '1234ABCD9876ZXCV' (default), and signature-length equals 16.

Test Data: guid='com.my.uuid', signing-key default='1234ABCD9876ZXCV', signature-length=16
Expected Result: All three qr.bangla properties are bound correctly: guid='com.my.uuid', signing-key='1234ABCD9876ZXCV' (default fallback), signature-length=16. No binding errors or type mismatches occur.
